hero.entradilla: Graphic and UX/UI designer in Valencia. Six chapters: what I draw, and what I'm asked for.

ilustracion.entradilla: Nobody asked me for four of these five.
ilustracion.declaracion: I draw in Procreate and I had never put these drawings in my portfolio. Maybe because they look nothing like the work I get asked for. Nobody asked me for four of the five, and only two of them carry a date. The fifth is the only one that answers to a brief, and you will see it in full in the campaign chapter.

pelo-cobre.linea: The hair covers more of the canvas than the face, and I painted its highlights strand by strand. I barely drew the coat at all: a dark mass and a pale collar.

panuelo.linea: I painted the whole face and the neck stayed as line: inside the contour there is no colour. The jaw stroke runs on past the chin. I signed and dated it all the same.

modigliani.linea: The neck runs down unbroken into the dress, and the dress is one dark mass without a fold. The lids come halfway down the eyes and the look goes to the floor.

nube.linea: I painted the face and the neck in full detail. At the shoulder the body comes apart into the ground. No clothing, no edge closing the figure.
nube.meta: 2048 × 2732 px · the only one that is not square · signed, undated

ceguera.linea: The only one that answers to a brief, and the only one without a single shadow: clear line over flat colour. The phone stands upright on her head and has grown an arm of its own. That arm covers her eyes while hers hang at her sides.
ceguera.meta: 3000 × 3000 px · from the Ceguera Digital campaign

marca.entradilla: Three identities, and the first one is mine.
marca.declaracion: A brand does not end at the logo: it ends when someone else can use it without calling me. Estudio Raíz is my own studio, so I was the client and the designer at once, and that is where you find out fast which decisions hold.

campana.entradilla: A drawing of mine ended up at bus-shelter scale.
campana.declaracion: Ceguera Digital is a public-service campaign about looking at your phone and missing your stop. The illustration that opens this portfolio belongs to it, and here you see it where it was meant to be: in the street, at a person's height.

producto.entradilla: Two apps, and the research that decided what they are.

vibe.nota: The whole screen as I delivered it, not a crop. It turns the cycle phase into what to prioritise and what to limit that week.

voluntee.nota: Ten filter groups on one screen: type, category, experience, organisation, days, schedule, family and age. Nothing hidden behind an accordion.

impreso.entradilla: Thirty A4 pages you turn with your hand.
impreso.declaracion: Paper does not let you take it back. A cover, a poster and thirty laid-out pages force you to settle the hierarchy before it prints, and that discipline is what I bring to a screen afterwards.

oficio.entradilla: Where I have worked, what I use, and how to write to me.
